name: workflow-gates
description: Draws the agentic-workflows engine's gates in the band above the prompt — rows a click puts in the prompt and a second click sends — instead of a menu the model has to reproduce; carries a handoff into a fresh conversation; appends the engine's note to a workflow conversation's compaction, so Claude re-reads what it works from; says the phase in the spinner; and refuses a direct edit of a workflow manifest.
